theme: Ordering monomers so the chain folds right
title: Copolymer Sequence Design for a Target Glass Transition
strategies: diagonal-only composition matching + uncontrolled (random) sequence: solve the linear/Fox mixing rule on pure-component Tg values for a feasible composition, then react in a seeded-random order -- nails the ratio, blind to blockiness

block segregation: arrange monomers as contiguous runs, choosing the block order so that a costly interaction pair is never adjacent -- exploits the harmonic dyad model when a junction is plasticizing
maximal alternation via deficit/fair-scheduling interleave: spread monomer types as evenly as possible to maximize cross-type bonds -- exploits the model when a junction is reinforcing

joint composition + arrangement search: grid over feasible compositions (respecting per-type feedstock caps) crossed with both structural extremes (all block permutations and the alternating interleave), plus a local refinement pass, minimizing the actual bond-weighted Tg error
